intro: Home tutors on Golf Course Road usually teach in one of two settings. The first is the DLF phases, from Phase 1 through Phase 5, with Sushant Lok 1 and Wazirabad close by, where most families live in independent floors on quiet residential lanes. The second is the run of gated high-rise towers on and just off the road itself, across Sectors 42, 43, 53 and 54, with Sectors 27, 28 and 52 also in the zone. Each setting asks something different of a parent: a floor needs a parking plan and a clear house number, while a tower needs a visitor entry set up before the tutor arrives.

Requests from this zone are unusually specific. A parent is as likely to ask for IB Maths Analysis and Approaches at Higher Level, or for IGCSE Chemistry structured questions, as for general Class 8 Maths, and CBSE and ICSE families add board-year Maths and Science to the mix. That makes subject fit the first filter and distance the second. Office traffic along the road and around the Rapid Metro is the real constraint on timing, so a class soon after the school bus drops your child home, or one that starts once the evening office rush has eased, is far easier to keep week after week than a slot right in the middle of it.

On NXTutors the tutor list for this zone starts with people who live in the DLF phases or on Golf Course Road, then tutors who have said they travel here, then the rest of Gurugram, and finally online specialists for a narrow IB or IGCSE paper. Send us the board, level and paper, your phase or tower, and the days that suit you. We shortlist two or three matched tutors, and each tutor's fee is on the shortlist before you book anything. The first class is a free demo at your home or online, and if the fit changes later in the year, moving to another tutor costs nothing.
faqs: Which parts of Gurugram does the Golf Course Road zone cover?

It covers DLF Phases 1 to 5, Sushant Lok 1 and Wazirabad, and Sectors 27, 28, 42, 43, 52, 53 and 54 along and near Golf Course Road. Each area in the zone has its own page on NXTutors listing the tutors nearest to it, and the list further down this page links to every one of them.
Is a DLF floor or a Golf Course Road tower easier for a home tutor?

Each has one hurdle. In a DLF floor the tutor walks straight to your door but may struggle to park in a narrow lane, so a two-wheeler often suits. In a tower, parking is simple once inside, but the tutor must be approved at the gate first, ideally as a regular visitor.
Can I find a tutor for one IB or IGCSE paper rather than a whole subject?

Yes. Families in this zone often want help with a single component, such as IB Maths AA at Higher Level or planning an IB Physics internal assessment. Name the board, level and paper when you ask. If nobody close by teaches it, we suggest an online specialist or a hybrid plan with a weekend home class.
What does the first class cost, and what if the tutor is not right?

The first class is a free demo, so you judge the teaching on your child's current topic before paying anything. You see each shortlisted tutor's hourly fee before that demo, because tutors set their own fees. If the tutor stops suiting your child later, we suggest another, and the switch is free.

intro: Families looking for home tutors in Cyber City and along MG Road live closer to Gurugram's busiest office district than anyone else in the city. The zone takes in Sectors 24, 25, 26 and 29, the neighbourhoods of Sikanderpur and Nathupur, the Udyog Vihar side and the homes around Cyber City itself. Housing sits in pockets between office blocks. The Yellow Line stops along MG Road and the Rapid Metro serves Cyber City, which helps a tutor who travels by train. The catch is that the roads here fill up twice a day, in the morning and again as offices empty, and in both directions.

That rhythm shapes the whole arrangement. A tutor who lives in the DLF phases, Sikanderpur or a neighbouring sector, or who is already teaching another child nearby that evening, tends to be the most punctual. Many parents here work in the same offices and get home late, so a common pattern is online classes on weekdays with the same tutor, then a longer home session at the weekend when a parent is in. For board-year students, hold the weekday slot steady rather than moving it around, because rescheduling at short notice is hard when every road is busy at the same hour.

NXTutors lists tutors for this zone nearest first: those based around MG Road and Cyber City, then tutors who travel into these sectors, then the wider city, and online tutors last. Tell us your block or society, the subject, class and board, and whether weekday online plus weekend home classes would suit your family. You get a shortlist of two or three tutors who fit, with each one's fee visible before any class takes place. The first session is a free demo, and if the tutor you pick stops working for your child, we find you another at no charge.
faqs: Do home tutors come to Cyber City homes on weekday evenings?

Yes, but the tutor's starting point matters more than usual. Tutors from Sikanderpur, the DLF phases or Sectors 24 to 29 handle the office rush more easily, and one who has a class nearby just before yours is often more punctual than one leaving home. If evenings are impossible, weekend home classes plus online sessions work well.
Which areas are in the MG Road and Cyber City zone?

Sectors 24, 25, 26 and 29, the stretch along MG Road, the homes around Cyber City, Udyog Vihar, Sikanderpur and Nathupur. Sectors 27 and 28 and the DLF phases fall in the Golf Course Road zone next door, and many tutors cover both, so check both zone pages if you live near the edge.
Is online tuition a good idea for families near the office district?

Often, for part of the week. When both parents work late, an online class on a weekday evening spares the tutor a crawl through office traffic and keeps the slot reliable. Keep at least one home class where the tutor sees your child's written work, and set up a camera over the notebook for online ones.
Why do we get two or three tutors rather than a long list?

Because NXTutors shortlists on board, class, subject, your slot and where the tutor starts from, not on the subject name alone. Two or three tutors who fit all of that are easier to compare than a long directory. You see each tutor's fee before choosing one for the free demo class.

intro: Central Gurugram spans Sectors 30 to 33, 38 to 41 and 44 to 46, with South City 1, Sushant Lok 2 and 3, Kanhai Colony, Jharsa village and the pockets around Millennium City Centre metro station. Much of it is HUDA plotted housing, such as the builder floors and independent houses of Sector 40, next to mid-rise apartments in Sector 39, older societies, and rented homes around Kanhai and Jharsa. The zone sits between NH-48 and Sohna Road, and office buildings in Sectors 39 and 44 add weekday traffic to both, which matters when you pick a class time.

Its position is its advantage. Tutors from the DLF side, Sohna Road and Golf Course Extension Road can all reach these sectors without crossing the whole city, and the Yellow Line terminus lets a metro-riding tutor finish with a short auto ride. A bigger pool is most useful in Classes 11 and 12, where a separate specialist for Physics, Chemistry or Maths often serves a student better than one tutor for everything. CBSE and ICSE make up most of the requests we see from these sectors, with IB and IGCSE tutors wanted for children at international schools across the city.

Tutor cards for Central Gurugram start with tutors who live in these sectors, then those who travel here from nearby zones, then the rest of Gurugram, and then online tutors. Because so many tutors can reach the centre, tell us exactly what you need: class, board, subject, the chapter causing trouble and the slot you can keep. We come back with two or three matched tutors and show each tutor's fee before the demo. That first class is free, and if you decide after a month that a different tutor would suit your child better, switching does not cost anything.
faqs: Which localities count as Central Gurugram?

South City 1, Sushant Lok 2 and 3, Kanhai Colony, Jharsa, and Sectors 30 to 33, 38 to 41 and 44 to 46, around Millennium City Centre metro station. South City 2 and the sectors further down Sohna Road are a separate zone, and Sushant Lok 1 falls in the Golf Course Road zone.
Can a tutor reach Central Gurugram by metro?

Yes. Millennium City Centre, the Yellow Line terminus, is close to Sectors 40 and 44, so a tutor coming from Delhi or from along the Yellow Line needs only a short auto ride at the end. Homes nearer NH-48, or deep inside Sectors 38 and 39, are more often reached by road.
Should a Class 11 student here have one tutor or several?

Usually several. The central sectors are within reach of tutors from most of the city, so taking a separate specialist for Physics, Chemistry or Maths is realistic. One tutor covering all three often spreads too thin once the Class 11 syllabus deepens, and JEE or NEET preparation raises the demands further.
Are we tied in once we choose a tutor?

No. There is no long contract to get out of. You meet the tutor at a free demo, knowing their fee in advance, and decide after that. If the arrangement stops working at any point, tell us and we suggest another matched tutor; switching on NXTutors is free.

intro: Golf Course Extension Road runs through Sectors 55 to 66, from Sectors 55, 56 and 57 at the northern end, past Sectors 58 to 62, on to Sectors 63, 65 and 66, with a band of HUDA plots in between. Most families live in large gated societies, many built in recent years, where visitor apps, guard calls and a long walk from the gate to the tower are part of every tutor's arrival. Some societies stop visitor entry after a set evening hour, which quietly decides the latest home slot you can book. NXTutors has its own office in Sector 66, on this road.

Children here often travel some way to school, so the bus can drop them home later than in older parts of the city; give them a break before class rather than booking the tutor for the moment they walk through the door. Families ask for CBSE, IB and IGCSE across all classes, and the specialist requests, such as IB Maths at Higher Level or IGCSE Additional Maths, are where a tutor from further away earns the trip. Tutors living on this road or in the Sohna Road sectors reach most societies comfortably, and weekend mornings tend to have more free tutors than weekday evenings.

Because NXTutors is based in Sector 66, this is the zone we know most closely. The tutors shown for it start with those who live along the Extension Road, then tutors who travel here, then the rest of Gurugram, then online. Give us your society, tower and the visitor cut-off time, along with the class, board and subject. We send two or three matched tutors, each with the fee shown before you book the free demo class. If the arrangement stops working, for instance after a change of school timetable, moving to a different tutor is free.
faqs: Which sectors are on Golf Course Extension Road?

Sectors 55 to 66, including Sectors 55, 56, 57, 58, 60, 61, 62, 63, 65 and 66, and the HUDA plots between the societies. North of Sector 55 is the Golf Course Road zone, and the sectors along the Southern Peripheral Road, Sectors 73 to 80, have their own zone page.
Our society closes visitor entry early. Can we still have home tuition?

Yes, as long as the home class ends before the cut-off. Ask your management office for the exact time before choosing a slot, and book the tutor comfortably ahead of it. Anything later in the evening, such as a doubt session before a test, can move online with the same tutor.
Why does the first class in a large society often start late?

The guard call, the ID check at the gate and the walk to the right tower all take time on a first visit. Approve the tutor on the society app the day before, tell them the nearest gate and where visitors park, and ask the management to note them as a frequent visitor after the demo.
Is NXTutors only for families near its Sector 66 office?

No. The office is on Golf Course Extension Road, but we arrange home tutoring across Gurugram and online tutoring across India. Wherever you live, you get two or three matched tutors, see each fee before a free demo class, and can switch tutor later without paying anything extra.

intro: The Sohna Road zone covers Sectors 47 to 51 and 67 to 72, including South City 2, Badshahpur and the large townships off the road, where gated high-rise societies, villa and floor enclaves and plotted homes sit side by side. Searches for home tutors on Sohna Road come from all three kinds of home, and each needs a different first visit: a township guard who rings you, a society app that needs pre-approval, or a floor where parking is the only question. CBSE and ICSE lead the requests we see from this zone, with IB and IGCSE a growing share.

One question decides most weekday arrangements here: which side of Sohna Road does the tutor start from? The road is slow at school and office hours, and a tutor who has to cross it at the wrong moment will struggle to arrive on time, however short the distance looks. It is often worth waiting a day or two for a tutor on your side. Board years drive demand in these sectors, from Class 10 Maths and Science to Class 12 Physics, Chemistry and Maths, plus JEE or NEET foundation from Class 9, usually alongside coaching rather than in place of it.

The tutors listed for Sohna Road begin with those who live in these sectors, followed by tutors who travel here from Golf Course Extension Road and other nearby zones, then the rest of the city, then online. When you ask, say which side of the road you live on and name your township or society, plus the class, board and subject. NXTutors sends two or three matched tutors and shows each fee before you book. Your first class is a free demo, and a later switch to another tutor is free too, which matters over a long board year.
faqs: Which areas are part of the Sohna Road zone?

Sectors 47, 48, 49, 50 and 51, Sectors 67 to 72, South City 2, Badshahpur and the townships and societies along Sohna Road. Central Gurugram, with South City 1 and Sushant Lok 2 and 3, is the neighbouring zone, and the Southern Peripheral Road sectors, 73 to 80, have a page of their own.
Does it matter which side of Sohna Road the tutor lives on?

For weekday evening classes, it often does. Crossing the road when school and office traffic peak can make a tutor late week after week. On weekend mornings it matters much less, so a tutor from across the road can still suit a Saturday or Sunday class, with online sessions on weekdays.
Our township has several gates. What should we tell the tutor?

Pick the entrance closest to your house or tower and share it with the tutor before the demo, along with the house or tower number. If the guard rings residents for new visitors, give the gate the tutor's name and phone number in advance so the first class is not held up at the entrance.
What happens in the free demo class?

The demo is an ordinary lesson on whatever your child is studying now, at home or online, so you see how the tutor actually teaches. You already know the tutor's fee by then. If the demo does not convince you, tell us and we arrange one with the next tutor on your shortlist.

intro: The Southern Peripheral Road zone takes in Sectors 73 to 80, a belt of newer high-rise societies between Sohna Road, Golf Course Extension Road and the New Gurugram sectors. Some societies here are long finished, while others are still growing, with construction continuing around completed towers. Distances between societies are longer than in the older city, and young families dominate, with children spread across many boards and school systems. For a home tutor that means two things: fewer students within easy reach of each other, and a first visit that depends on knowing the exact tower and gate.

The tutors who reach SPR most comfortably live on Golf Course Extension Road or in the Sohna Road sectors. Because fewer tutors live inside the belt, reliability counts for more than a perfect profile: a tutor who already teaches another child in your society will keep turning up through exam season in a way a long-distance tutor may not. For Classes 11 and 12, many families here settle on a hybrid plan, with a home session each week for new topics and written work, and online classes for doubts and tests. Ask every tutor where they will set out from on your class days.

For SPR, NXTutors shows tutors who live in these sectors first, then tutors who have said they come here, then the rest of Gurugram, then online tutors, so a thin local list never leaves the page empty. Tell us your society and tower, the class and board, and whether a hybrid plan is acceptable, because saying yes widens the shortlist. You receive two or three matched tutors, see what each charges before the demo, and take the first class free. Changing tutor later, if a closer one becomes available, is free as well.
faqs: Which sectors are on the Southern Peripheral Road?

Sectors 73, 74, 75, 76, 77, 78, 79 and 80. The Golf Course Extension Road and Sohna Road sectors sit on either side, and New Gurugram is next to the belt. Families near the edge of SPR can also check the tutors listed on those neighbouring zone pages.
Why are there fewer home tutors living on SPR?

The societies are newer and some are still being built around the finished towers, so fewer tutors have settled here yet. Longer distances between societies also mean each tutor can reach fewer homes in an evening. A tutor from Golf Course Extension Road or Sohna Road, or a hybrid plan, fills the gap.
Does online tuition work for a senior student on SPR?

Yes, if the setup is right. Use a laptop or tablet rather than a phone, plus a pen tablet or a camera angled at the notebook, so the tutor can follow working in Maths and Physics. Many Class 11 and 12 students here combine one home class a week with online sessions.
Can we change tutor if a closer one turns up later?

Yes. Switching tutor is free on NXTutors, so you can start with the strongest tutor available now, online or hybrid, and move to someone nearer when one appears. Tell us what worked and what did not, and we shortlist again, showing each tutor's fee before you choose.

intro: New Gurugram covers Sectors 81 to 95 off NH-48, including Sectors 82, 83, 84, 85, 86, 88, 89, 90, 92 and 93, and is made up largely of newer gated societies spread across a wide area. Drives between one society and the next are longer than anywhere in the older city, and in several sectors finished towers stand beside plots still under construction. Families here come from many cities and school systems, so a single society can hold CBSE, ICSE, IB and IGCSE students of every age. For home tuition, the question is how many tutors live close enough to come regularly.

Tutor supply is thinner here than in the central sectors, so the right person may live across the city. Two habits help. First, keep one regular slot rather than moving it, since a tutor coming a long way builds the rest of the week around your class. Second, be open to weekend mornings, when roads are quieter and tutors have fewer competing bookings. Where the nearest specialist is too far for weekday visits, online and hybrid classes let you choose on teaching quality rather than distance, with one home class a week keeping the personal contact.

NXTutors fills the tutor list for New Gurugram in order of distance: tutors living in Sectors 81 to 95 first, then tutors who travel into them, then tutors elsewhere in the city, then online tutors from across India. Ask with your sector, society and tower, the class, board and subject, and say whether hybrid lessons are fine. We send two or three matched tutors with their fees on view before any class. The first one is a free demo, which can run online if the tutor lives far off, and if you later find someone closer, switching is free.
faqs: Which sectors are in New Gurugram?

Sectors 81 to 95, including Sectors 81, 82, 83, 84, 85, 86, 88, 89, 90, 92 and 93 and the societies inside them. The Southern Peripheral Road sectors, 73 to 80, and the Dwarka Expressway sectors are neighbouring zones, and tutors who cover those often travel here too.
How do we find a reliable home tutor when few live nearby?

Ask first for tutors in your sector or the next one, and say you are open to a tutor who already teaches in your society. If the local list is short, start online with a strong tutor and add a weekly home visit once the routine settles. A fixed slot also makes a long trip worthwhile.
Why are weekend mornings popular for tuition in New Gurugram?

The roads are quieter, gates are less busy, and tutors have fewer bookings than on weekday evenings, when every family wants the same hours. School buses in the newer sectors can also bring children home late, so a longer weekend session plus a shorter weekday online class is a common pattern.
Will a tutor charge more to travel to New Gurugram?

Tutors set their own fees, and travel is one of the things that can move a quote, so a tutor coming from across the city may ask more than one in the next sector. You see every shortlisted tutor's fee before the free demo, so you can compare a nearby tutor, a hybrid plan and online classes side by side.

intro: The Dwarka Expressway zone runs from Sectors 34 to 37, including 36A, 37C and 37D, out along the expressway through Sectors 99 to 115, with Sectors 99A, 102, 103, 104, 106, 108, 109, 110A, 112 and 113 among them. It is mostly high-rise societies, many handed over recently, with the expressway itself as the spine and Palam Vihar and the older sectors close by. Families often arrive here from Delhi or another city part-way through a school year, so the first tuition request is frequently about catching up with a new school or a new board.

A move like that shows up as gaps. A Class 9 student arriving from a state board into CBSE, for example, may find the pace and the competency-based questions unfamiliar, and a younger child may have met some topics in a different order. A tutor who has handled that kind of switch can locate the missing chapters quickly, usually by teaching at home first and then moving to a hybrid rhythm. Tutors living along the expressway or in Palam Vihar can reach many societies, while an IB or IGCSE specialist may be easier to find online. Where a tower's gate app is not running yet, give the guard the tutor's details before each class.

On this page the tutors for Dwarka Expressway come in order: those who live in the expressway sectors, then tutors who travel here, then the rest of Gurugram, then online. When you ask, mention the board or school your child has just left as well as the new one, plus your sector, society and tower. NXTutors shortlists two or three matched tutors and shows their fees before the demo. The first class is a free demo, and if the tutor does not suit the new routine, switching later costs nothing.
faqs: Which sectors does the Dwarka Expressway zone include?

Sectors 34 to 37 with 36A, 37C and 37D, and Sectors 99 to 115 along the expressway, such as 99A, 102, 106, 109, 112 and 113. Palam Vihar and Sectors 1 to 23 form the Old Gurugram zone next door, and tutors from there often cover the nearer expressway sectors.
My child has just changed board. Can a tutor help with the switch?

Yes, and it is one of the most common reasons families here ask. Tell us the old and new board or school so we look for a tutor who has handled that change. A few weeks of home classes to find and fill the gaps, then a lighter hybrid plan, usually settles a child into the new pace.
Can tutors from Palam Vihar or Delhi reach the expressway sectors?

Tutors from Palam Vihar and the older sectors can reach many of the nearer expressway societies, and Palam Vihar itself draws tutors from the Dwarka side of Delhi. How practical the trip is depends on the hour, so ask each tutor where they will start from on your class days.
How are fees set for tutors on the Dwarka Expressway?

Each tutor chooses their own fee, and it is shown to you before the demo. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.

intro: Old Gurugram is the city's settled core: Sectors 1 to 23 and Palam Vihar, with neighbourhoods such as Shivaji Nagar, New Colony, Laxman Vihar, Krishna Colony and the lanes around Sadar Bazar. Homes are mostly HUDA plots with independent houses and builder floors, plus Housing Board flats in the Basai Road cluster and apartments among the shops of Sector 21. Gurgaon Railway Station is close to Sectors 4 and 7, Palam Vihar Halt serves the northern sectors, and IFFCO Chowk on the Yellow Line is near Sectors 14, 15 and 17, although most tutors still arrive by road.

Tutors are plentiful here, and a lot of them have taught board classes in the same few sectors for years; with short trips between houses, a schedule of several weekly visits is easy to hold. CBSE leads, ICSE follows, and Hindi, Sanskrit and Accountancy tutors, harder to find in the newer sectors, are easier to find here. Parents often ask one tutor to teach two siblings or cousins one after the other on the same visit, which works well up to Class 10. Afternoon slots suit children who get home early, while evenings near the markets and NH-48 run slower.

The tutor list for Old Gurugram begins with tutors who live in Sectors 1 to 23 or Palam Vihar, then tutors who travel here, then the rest of the city, then online tutors for international boards or rare subjects. Give us your sector or colony with a landmark, the class and board of every child who needs help, and the afternoon or evening you prefer. NXTutors sends two or three matched tutors with fees visible before you book. The first class is a free demo, and switching to a different tutor later is free, so there is little risk in trying a local teacher.
faqs: Which areas are in the Old Gurugram zone?

Sectors 1 to 23, including Sectors 4, 5, 7, 9, 10, 10A, 12, 14, 15, 17, 21, 22, 23 and 23A, plus Palam Vihar, Shivaji Nagar, New Colony, Laxman Vihar, Krishna Colony and the Sadar Bazar area. Sector 24 onwards, towards MG Road, belongs to the MG Road and Cyber City zone.
Can tutors from Delhi teach in Palam Vihar?

Often, yes. Palam Vihar sits against the Delhi border near Dwarka, so a tutor may come from neighbouring Gurugram sectors such as 22 and 23 or from the Dwarka side of Delhi. The nearest metro, Dwarka Sector 21, is a drive away, so most tutors still finish the trip by road.
Can one tutor teach two children in the same house?

In many homes, yes. Up to Class 10, a tutor can take the two children one after the other on the same visit, which saves travel for everyone. Mention every child's class, board and subjects in your request so the shortlist fits both. From Class 11, a separate subject specialist per child usually works better.
How do we know who is coming to the door when there is no guard?

Tutors who join NXTutors go through an ID check, with a one-time code on their phone or email and a government photo ID that the team reviews. That is not a police or background check, so meet the tutor at the free demo, keep an adult at home during classes and hold lessons in a shared room.
